persistence: React state only; no build-specific storage
logging: no build-specific external analytics or telemetry path identified
exportShare: explicit local JSON export; no URL share
support: core uses standard browser HTML/JS and does not depend on experimental browser AI APIs
minimization: only fields needed to identify a source, record an analyst claim, preserve verification state and export the research record are requested
warnings: do not enter confidential, personal, privileged or otherwise restricted material unless authorized to process it in the current browser/device
a URL/location field can itself contain sensitive information
local browser processing does not make the surrounding device or browser environment inherently secure
